body.statement: When \(d=0\), the capsule selects two disjoint fixed-size simple random samples, the arm swap gives the standard balanced two-arm design, and the risk certificate reduces to \(R_2(G)=\Theta(n^{-1})\), agreeing with the classical no-interference finite-population rate.
body.justification: This verifies that the construction collapses to a known parametric design when radius-two conflicts disappear.
body.gap: The reduction is a required sanity check rather than a novelty claim.
body.consumer: It lets users interpret the degree-dependent frontier as the exact inflation over ordinary randomized experimentation.
